title: Analysis: AI chip rivalry shifts toward system-level capabilities as AMD challenges Nvidia's full-stack ecosystem
html:
Amid the wave of controversy and headlines surrounding Jensen Huang, AMD announced on November 16 that it had completed its acquisition of World Labs in an all-stock transaction worth approximately US$8.2 billion.
